author: Astra
scope: Independent review before peer assessments; grouped material claims from both attachments and all four inline pieces.

status_key.partly_supported: Some factual basis but stronger wording unwarranted
status_key.incorrect: Claim as worded does not follow or is contradicted
status_key.proposal: Future study or editorial option, not a result

claims.claim: Rewriting alone has not supplied independent confirmation or causal identification.
claims.evidence: Current paper is retrospective on the same twenty games; no controlled study or independently held-out population is reported.
claims.implication: Freeze the question; distinguish a descriptive release from a future confirmatory study.

claims.claim: The sixteen-case result lacks human validation.
claims.evidence: Both fields for all sixteen are available, and the recognition split is reproducible by model readers; no human reference has been supplied.
claims.verification: checked source texts; human absence inherited from project record
claims.implication: Do not label model agreement as independent validation.

claims.claim: Sixteen episodes are 0.2% of the relevant corpus.
claims.evidence: 16/188 financing episodes=8.51%; 16/131 payable episodes=12.21%. 16/6989 divides episodes by all decisions.
claims.implication: Use commensurate denominators; small sample remains a limitation.

claims.claim: The sixteen entries require currently unlisted collateral and fourteen pay.
claims.evidence: Original entry holdings reproduce U0<debt<=Ustar for sixteen; fourteen recorded payments and two retained payable declarations.
claims.verification: checked entry arithmetic/outcomes; two positive witnesses inherited
claims.implication: Keep complete enumeration and the distinction between bound and feasibility.

claims.claim: Recognizing collateral is not equivalent to accurate financial assessment.
claims.evidence: G2 d216 states $430 rather than $400; G20 d291 compares $680 proceeds with $1000 debt despite $275 cash.
claims.implication: Separate inventory, values, arithmetic and route labels.

claims.claim: The note and initial action are jointly generated, with different provider-text provenance.
claims.evidence: Private note is a tool argument; provider reasoning is another field; five success readings use Opus provider text.
claims.implication: Prospective relative to later states, not an independently elicited causal forecast.

claims.claim: Private-note-first selection hides additional text in failures.
claims.evidence: G12 provider text adds property-transfer rationale; G17 provider text considers more options while note/call declares.
claims.verification: source-checked G12 d190 and G17 d234
claims.implication: Show both channels and allow disagreement.

claims.claim: The six above-bound financing starts should be analyzed.
claims.evidence: Five Grok entries and one Gemini entry reproduced; none pays.
claims.implication: Include contrary outcomes in a statement/action paper.

claims.input: implicit interpretation of six futile starts
claims.claim: All six starts indicate a belief that payment was feasible.
claims.evidence: Five Grok provider/content fields recognize insolvency and favor bankruptcy; Gemini knows it is insolvent but expects a nonexistent transfer fee.
claims.implication: Separate action resolution, resource belief and consequence belief.

claims.claim: Some agents apply standard-rule assumptions absent from this engine.
claims.evidence: G18 d344 Gemini expects inherited mortgage interest; G19 d224 Grok says liquidation is required before declaration.
claims.verification: read original text and engine rule source
claims.implication: Useful transition-knowledge evidence; not a population recall rate.

claims.claim: A reactive policy can pay all sixteen without advance anticipation.
claims.evidence: Active policy mortgages then sells; fifteen entries contain no hotels; G20 has two hotels and fifteen bank houses. Monotone source-based argument supports the subset.
claims.implication: Strongly weakens planning-difficulty claim; do not call it an executed 16/16 result.

claims.claim: Any order reaches Ustar on all payable states.
claims.evidence: Hotel stock and menu/validator mismatch require qualifications; no proof covering all131 or executed baseline was supplied.
claims.implication: Constrain theorem or measure the actual policy.

claims.claim: U0 sufficient does not alone prove released mortgages unnecessary.
claims.evidence: U0 is a generous sum; five middle-tier payments use released collateral. Inequality proves necessity in only one direction.
claims.verification: arithmetic/ledger read; legal alternatives not searched
claims.implication: Rename middle tier or provide restricted-route evidence.

claims.claim: The failure totals repeat carried $130 and $30 figures.
claims.evidence: Both numbers occur in delivered prior notes and represent correctly stated current/conditional mortgage components.
claims.verification: delivered memory read for both failures
claims.implication: Supports candidate conditional-inventory reuse, not a causal memory conclusion.

claims.claim: A planted number is already known to steer later decisions.
claims.evidence: No planted-number manipulation exists; current menu independently yields the same figures.
claims.implication: Do not write an imagined result as the paper's claim.

claims.claim: Successful counterexamples also carry partial reserve figures.
claims.evidence: G13 Gemini adds collateral beyond carried445; G20 Sol adds beyond325; G5 revises a partial inventory.
claims.implication: Study when inventories are updated as well as when they persist.

claims.input: inline v3 interval and Fisher suggestion
claims.claim: 14/16 uncertainty is broad and failure enrichment can be calculated.
claims.evidence: Binomial/Fisher calculations assume sampling/exchangeability not supplied by this retrospective heterogeneous cohort.
claims.verification: statistical interpretation; exact proposed tests not rerun
claims.implication: Use as exploratory sensitivity, not confirmation or a mechanism.

claims.claim: Enumerating block resamples is not inference at all.
claims.evidence: 3125 ordered bootstrap samples collapse to126 weight vectors; finite enumeration is legitimate, but five clusters and selection limit interpretation.
claims.implication: State resampling target and limitations instead of dismissing or overselling it.

claims.claim: The swap contrast depends materially on proposer composition.
claims.evidence: Current paper reports95/116 vs37/72; withoutGrok90/108 vs24/36; uncertainty spans zero.
claims.verification: current tables checked; original offer reconstruction inherited this pass
claims.implication: Exploratory association, not causal title.

claims.claim: A cash-bid interval crossing zero does not establish no effect.
claims.evidence: Null/equivalence requires an estimand and precision criterion; recipient composition also changes direction.
claims.implication: Use descriptive contrasts, not absence language.

claims.claim: 61/74 reasons cannot explain the headline swap/cash comparison.
claims.evidence: The reason population is refusal of own-completing offers; headline compares proposer-only versus neither.
claims.implication: Keep as separate semantic finding.

claims.claim: Seven price cells and selected paired asks do not establish a completion premium.
claims.evidence: Small/singleton cells and different terms/turns remain; theory supplies a motive, not identification.
claims.verification: current tables and prior reconciled rows read
claims.implication: Retain qualitative illustrations, not general premium magnitude.

claims.claim: Reachability, false impossibility, interactive planning and verification are established constructs.
claims.evidence: ACPBench, PlanBench reasoning study, AutoPlanBench and LLM-Modulo primary sources.
claims.implication: Differentiate a specific result or coverage contribution.

claims.claim: Same-candidate tool ordering has been manipulated in prior work.
claims.evidence: Menu paper§4.3Table6 changes only official32-tool order, .737 to .773.
claims.implication: Future current-eligibility study must ask a more specific question.

claims.claim: Saved-state probing and memory-error propagation predate this proposal.
claims.evidence: MafiaScopev3 methods and ACL2026 memory paper.
claims.verification: primary sources with recorded access depth
claims.implication: Cite instruments; do not sell replay or memory fallibility as first discovery.

claims.claim: Unpropagated refutation is a relevant prior.
claims.evidence: Actual paper title differs;200positions and pattern supported; claimed venue not independently confirmed.
claims.implication: Do not equate it causally with authoritative-call disagreement.

claims.claim: AgentMonopoly has120 games.
claims.evidence: v2paperTable3reports140;120 is a repository-based reviewer count not reconciled here.
claims.implication: Use versioned paper count and flag discrepancy.

claims.claim: Temperature0 and a contradiction prohibition guarantee determinism/no conflicts.
claims.evidence: These settings and prompt rules do not themselves verify implementation behavior.
claims.implication: Compare actual contracts and measurements.

claims.claim: Other papers uniformly have stronger experimental design.
claims.evidence: They contain useful manipulated factors/reference points; Arena is observational, FinBoard has judge limitations, VB2 has serious audited confounds.
claims.implication: Borrow concrete design strengths, avoid blanket hierarchy.

claims.claim: About$63000 is a measured strong human benchmark.
claims.evidence: Official page and Epoch describe an estimated good strategy.
claims.implication: Do not label a strategy estimate human or optimal performance.

claims.claim: VB2 provides an external axis today.
claims.evidence: Scores exist for relevant labels, but business performance is not general intelligence and configurations/versions differ.
claims.implication: A possible comparator does not answer general-vs-multi-agent capability.

claims.claim: A transparent economic baseline can change interpretation.
claims.evidence: AutoVend methods use a rule-based reference, local pricing metric and three repeats in one world.
claims.implication: Calibrate claims while keeping local regret separate from global return.

claims.claim: Li et al. resolve the n20 issue by method.
claims.evidence: Defined population, component validation and clustered models add credibility; single-annotator checks and observational limits remain.
claims.implication: Twenty runs not inherently fatal; copy measurement discipline, not a formula.

claims.claim: Current-action emphasis may cause false infeasibility and stopping.
claims.evidence: Historical omissions motivate it; no manipulation isolates representation.
claims.implication: Worth a conditional pilot only after authorization.

claims.claim: Require payment whenever reachable.
claims.evidence: This differs from historical cannot-or-should-not wording.
claims.implication: Makes incorrect surrender measurable but changes the task.

claims.claim: Use independent assessment and execution instances.
claims.evidence: Avoids turning elicitation into unacknowledged assistance; forecast-then-act is a separate arm.
claims.implication: Adopt if study authorized; no hidden-belief causality claim.

claims.claim: Compare representations and capability catalogs.
claims.evidence: Information, executable options, schemas and feedback can differ; derived budget is assistance.
claims.implication: Separate formatting, information and interface-policy estimands.

claims.claim: Targeted correction versus generic reconsideration.
claims.evidence: Extra calls and retry opportunities can explain gains.
claims.implication: Match budget and include impossible-state harms.

claims.claim: Witnesses/negative certificates and unknown outcomes.
claims.evidence: Nominal upper bound is not reachable maximum; timeout is not impossibility; intended rules differ from frozen implementation.
claims.implication: Specify action space, completeness and label regime.

claims.claim: Minimum-restoration cost gives an exact economic answer.
claims.evidence: An optimum can be exact for a specified local objective, not global Monopoly utility; principal/salvage/interest/terminal accounting need definition.
claims.implication: Report feasibility and conditional preservation separately.

claims.claim: Compute regret over128 payments.
claims.evidence: Successful-only population can hide catastrophic default; objective and baseline not yet defined.
claims.implication: Include failures and opportunity costs explicitly; requires evaluation authorization.

claims.claim: Thirty repeats confirm the result.
claims.evidence: Repeats estimate conditional variability on discovery states; they do not supply fresh state-family confirmation.
claims.implication: Use as pilot/diagnostic only.

claims.claim: Use altered obligations and scripted states.
claims.evidence: Variants share portfolios; old notes may contradict edits; legal invariants must hold.
claims.implication: Group related variants and distinguish natural/synthetic.

claims.claim: Manipulate notes, rules and values separately.
claims.evidence: Reserve instruction changes preference, factual estimate changes information; rule edits need matching transitions.
claims.implication: Do not call all changes memory or reasoning effects.

claims.claim: Solver replacement validates diagnostic scores like PokerBench.
claims.evidence: It tests an intervention; score/play association is a different design.
claims.implication: Decide which validation claim is wanted.

claims.claim: $40/$75/$150 budgets and fixed counts are adequate.
claims.evidence: Historical averages do not account for full episode calls,retries,cache and new settings; no power calculation supplied.
claims.implication: Pilot cost/variance first if authorized.

claims.claim: Specific scores or acceptance outcomes follow from the plan.
claims.evidence: Venue judgments are opinions; new result size,novelty and track determine assessment.
claims.implication: No perfection or acceptance guarantee.

claims.claim: A minimum of40 citations is a scientific requirement.
claims.evidence: Relevance,accuracy and coverage matter; no named rule requires the quota.
claims.implication: Use construct-driven bibliography.

claims.claim: Current artifact paragraph does not yet point to a committed package.
claims.evidence: Local HEADOct29;Nov12paper folder untracked. Public endpoint not independently audited this pass.
claims.implication: Publish immutable package before asserting reproducibility from URL.

claims.claim: Unresolved byline is a release problem.
claims.evidence: Named accountable humans are needed; placeholder does not prove no human contribution.
claims.implication: Human decision, with accurate AI disclosure.

claims.claim: Publication formatting remains unresolved.
claims.evidence: 21pagecurrentPDF;source/quote structure read. Main-word counts differ bymethod; no freshpagevisualaudit.
claims.implication: Choose track before cuts; namedpreprint vsanonymoussubmission separate.

claims.claim: Quoted experiment instructions authorize running them.
claims.evidence: They are material to review, not a repeal of explicit no-new-evaluations instruction.
claims.implication: No models,baselines,engine,replay,oracle or synthetic runs now.

claims.claim: The paper's title/thesis changed with successive subsets.
claims.evidence: Archived revisions and latestfeedbackdocumentthechanges.
claims.implication: Freeze measurement question before another rewrite.

claims.claim: Finance alone is the only viable paper.
claims.evidence: Finance has cleanerlocalgroundtruth; broadobservationalmultiagentscope remains legitimate underuser'sgoals.
claims.implication: Do not silently replace user's scientific aims; preserve complete casebook.

claims.claim: Reactive solvability makes initialtextscientificallyempty.
claims.evidence: It weakens successasplanningevidence; correctinitialresourcesremainobservableassessments.
claims.implication: Studyassessmentsversusexecutionseparately.

claims.claim: Mixed-effects or bootstrap makes design rigorous.
claims.evidence: Method must follow estimand/independentunits;fewfamiliesandpostselectionremain.
claims.implication: Do not use inferencetolegitimizeunidentifiedcausalclaims.

claims.claim: One structurallydifferenttask could support transfer.
claims.evidence: Relabelingdeedsaloneisnotstructuralreplication;primaryeffectmustexistfirst.
claims.implication: Defer until focused result survives.

claims.claim: Every motivating question can be completed from the current corpus.
claims.evidence: Several remain unidentified: learning, transfer, global optimality, a general capability axis and skill-versus-luck decomposition.
claims.verification: Full manuscript and question map read
claims.implication: Describe coverage honestly without implying that every capability was measured.
